conditions: Conformance fixtures should simulate client profiles and schema projection without requiring live Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClo/OpenClaw, Hermes, or embedding provider calls.
No MCP indexing/import/reconciliation control tools should be added.

Broken links must remain non-blocking diagnostic graph edges; conformance fixtures should verify redacted diagnostic exposure and that unresolved edges do not affect resolved-link ranking/filter behavior.
rationale: Existing MCP tests already compare tool names/schema parity. The new requirement mainly expands those fixtures to check descriptions, portable schema constructs, output bounds, redacted corrective errors, and client-profile golden prompts.
